_readme: The record in the bottom right of freeplay and the week name under it. These are already
the built-in defaults - the file is here so they can be changed without rebuilding. Back
out of freeplay and go back in; it is read fresh every time the menu is built.
The name is set from letterstuff.png next to this file, which carries A to Z and nothing
else - no digits, no full stop, no apostrophe - and sets lowercase as the same capitals.
A week whose name carries one of those characters will be missing it.
fitMode says what happens when a name is wider than widthBudget:
overflow  - nothing, it runs past
shrink    - set it smaller until it fits, no smaller than shrinkFloor
wrap      - break it across lines
wrapThenShrink - break it across lines, and shrink if the widest line is still too wide
A name that hits shrinkFloor and is still too wide overflows; that is the floor's job.
widthBudget is in pixels and size is the point size before any shrinking. linePercent is
the gap between lines as a percentage of the size.
The letters are drawn white inside a black outline. fill is AARRGGBB, or RRGGBB for a
fully opaque colour, and tints the insides; the outline stays black. fillTakesSongColor
uses the selected song's colour instead of fill.
centreX and recordY are where the record's middle goes, measured in the 1280x720 the menu
is laid out for. centreX is held the same distance from the right edge on a wider screen.
gapUnderRecord is from the record's middle down to the middle of the name block, so a name
that wraps to two lines grows both ways from the same place rather than drifting down.
spinRpm is how fast the record turns. 0 stops it. showRecord false leaves just the name.
